coverage.method: mechanical name match (exact struct/enum name, case-insensitive struct name, or exact snake_case filename) across the full enumerated vanilla class list -- no AI, no sampling

fidelity_sample.method: stratified random sample (seed 262, up to 6 per subsystem) of COVERED classes only, compared against decompiled vanilla by an AI agent reading both sides
fidelity_sample.caveat: This is a partial sample, not a full measurement. Do not report fidelity_pass_rate_pct as if it applies to unchecked_subsystems.

composite_caveat: coverage_pct_x (40.72%) is a real full-population measurement. fidelity_pass_rate_pct (50.0%) is from a 16-unit sample covering only ['block', 'entity', 'inventory'], not ['border', 'chunk', 'commands', 'food', 'gameevent', 'item', 'lighting', 'material', 'protocol', 'saveddata', 'server_level', 'storage', 'worldgen']. composite_estimate_pct = coverage * fidelity is therefore an ESTIMATE that assumes the sampled fidelity rate generalizes to unchecked subsystems and to match-kind categories not yet spot-checked. State the sample size whenever this number is quoted.
